paragraph_requires: Basic net loss per share is the same as diluted net loss per share because the Company reported net losses for all periods presented
using the treasury stock method or the if-converted method based on the nature of such securities
decisions.reader_note: For Intapp’s fiscal years ended June 30, 2024, 2025 and 2026, basic and diluted loss per share are equal because potential common shares are anti-dilutive in these loss periods. The filing describes treasury-stock or if-converted treatment according to the security’s nature; the EPS note specifies the treasury-stock method. The June fiscal dates, scale-three share counts and scale-zero EPS are retained under the thousands heading; these are not December calendar-year figures.

paragraph_requires: (in thousands, except share and per share data)
outstanding during the period including contingently issuable shares
Because the impact of the options and non-vested RSUs are anti-dilutive during periods of net loss
decisions.reader_note: For Evolus in 2023–2025, the basic denominator already includes contingently issuable shares under the filing’s stated policy. Options and non-vested RSUs are excluded from diluted loss per share as anti-dilutive; they should not be added to that denominator. The filing describes the treasury-stock method for potential dilution. Full scale-zero share counts follow the share/per-share exception to the thousands heading. EPS uses net loss, not comprehensive loss after currency-translation adjustments.
